mapper.select:
select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Code as secCode, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, c1.C_Name as prTendereeName, c2.C_Name as prBidWinnerName, c4.C_Name as tendereeName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, c1.C_Abbreviation as prTendereeAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as prBidWinAbbName, c4.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, sd.D_Amount as dAmount,
f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Sec_Publicity_Results mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Pr_Tenderee=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Pr_Bid_Winner=c2.C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Pr_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency left join Sec_Document sd on mn.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id and sd.D_State=7 where mn.Pr_Id=#{prId} order by sd.D_Create_Time desc limit 1

select count(1) from Sec_Publicity_Results mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Pr_Tenderee=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Pr_Bid_Winner=c2.C_Id where 1=1

select count(1) from Sec_Publicity_Results mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Pr_Tenderee=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Pr_Bid_Winner=c2.C_Id where 1=1
mapper.sql: (select sd.D_Name from Pre_Project pro left join Sec_Project sp on pro.P_Id = sp.P_Id left join Sys_Department sd on sd.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where sd.D_Name is not null and sp.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id limit 1) as pCompetentDepartmentName,

(select wm_concat(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')

mapper.sql: (select string_agg(P_Id,',') from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')

mapper.sql: (select GROUP_CONCAT(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
